title: Trump says the Iran war played a part in Republican midterm losses
caption:
Democrats won control of both the US House and Senate in Tuesday's midterm elections, AP projects. President Trump says the war with Iran, which pushed up fuel prices, was part of the reason, but says it was worth it. The new Congress takes office in January.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
